name: paper-garden
description: Folded-paper flowers in Daylight and pale blue with blue and cyan accents; light enough for dark text.
prompt: A garden of folded-paper flowers and leaves in daylight white and pale blue-grey, with a few accents in electric blue and luminous cyan, softly lit with a shallow depth of field, a light and airy ground that dark text can sit on. Colour palette strictly limited to deep navy #121B2A, electric blue #1B56FF, luminous cyan #00D5FF and pale daylight #F4F7FB, with their in-between shades. Premium, calm editorial brand imagery with generous negative space and soft light from the upper left. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, robots, circuit patterns, sparkles, purple or pink.
